items.snippet: Using corporate registry data, the article maps where state-affiliated capital e...
items.raw_snippet:
Using corporate registry data, the article maps where state-affiliated capital enters otherwise private technology groups and AI unicorns. The analysis shows that state capital is positioned at multiple points within AI ownership, investment, and deployment networks, typically in subsidiaries below the apex. Some of these positions create durable channels through which the development of technology, pilot projects, standard setting, and deployment can be coordinated with policy priorities. [...] The article conceptualizes China’s approach to state capitalism in the AI sector as a networked system of state capital and institutionalized state-private encounters rather than a binary divide between state-owned and private firms.

items.title: Algorithmic Governance: Why AI Needs Clear Rules | SAP
items.snippet:
<#>

secondary

Artificial Intelligence is no longer an experimental technology....
items.raw_snippet:
<#>

secondary

Artificial Intelligence is no longer an experimental technology. At home, we read about AI, consult it, question how it is used, and constantly look for ways to optimize its capabilities. Something similar is happening in companies: AI is actively involved in decisions related to credit approvals, fraud detection, pricing, the creation of written, graphic, and audiovisual content, the automation of business processes, customer service, and many other specialized functions. [...] There are different realities and outstanding challenges in the adoption process, but the main issue is a gap between stated commitments and actual maturity. As companies seek to scale AI solutions, they encounter strategies without adequate funding, infrastructure bottlenecks, and a lack of global standards. [...] A company that implements active transparency mechanisms immediately stands out. Many Latin American companies that sell services to, or are part of, global value chains need to be able to demonstrate how they govern and control the AI systems they use.

[...] One estimate, published recently in an academic paper00365-3), is that by 2027, AI servers could consume similar levels of electricity as Argentina consumes in a year. If Google switched its entire search business to AI, this paper argues, it would almost double its energy consumption, equivalent to what Ireland consumes in a year.

Title: Deadline: NLN/Walden Institute for Artificial Intelligence Academy Applications
National League for Nursing logo. # Deadline: NLN/Walden Institute for Artificial Intelligence Academy Applications. The NLN | Walden University College of Nursing Institute for Artificial Intelligence Academy is designed for nurses practicing in multiple roles (e.g. education, clinical, research, policy) and interprofessional colleagues who are working to address the existing and emerging impacts of AI in nursing education and desire a formal program to be better equipped, empowered, and inspired to lead in the AI era. During this year-long program, a cohort of peers examines the curricular, student learning, administrative, and clinical practice aspects of how AI is and will continue to influence nurse educator practice. Throughout the year, participants will be encouraged to engage in research and scholarly activities to enhance well-being and their AI knowledge and skills. ###### Consent to Use of Image, Name & Other Likeness. *By attending any NLN events or entering in the facility in which any events take place, you agree that the NLN and/or third parties authorized by the NLN may photograph or record your likeness, image, name, voice, and/or words, and may publish, display, reproduce, copy and distribute your likeness, image, name, voice, and/or words for promotional, educational, or membership activities worldwide in all forms of media now known or later developed, including but not limited to advertising, training, websites, presentations and marketing materials. You further acknowledge that the NLN and/or third parties authorized by the NLN shall have the right, but not the obligation, to identify you in connection with such media by name and/or affiliation.*.
